summary: You came in because your blood pressure has been high. Your doctor thinks hypertension is the main concern. Take your new medicine and schedule follow-up labs.

reason_for_visit.description: You reported several home blood pressure readings above your usual range.

diagnosis.changed_since_last_visit: It has stayed high since your last visit.

details.title: Hypertension
details.description: The force of blood against your blood vessel walls is too high.
details.what_it_means_for_you: This can strain your heart over time if it is not controlled.

medications.title: Lisinopril 10 milligrams
medications.why: It helps lower your blood pressure.
medications.instructions: Take it at the same time each day.
medications.side_effects_to_watch: Call your doctor if you have dizziness or swelling.

tests.title: Basic metabolic panel
tests.why: It checks kidney function after starting blood pressure medicine.
tests.description: A blood draw measures salts and kidney markers.

procedures.title: Blood pressure recheck
procedures.why: It shows whether the medicine is working.
procedures.what_to_expect: A clinician will measure your blood pressure in the clinic.

other.title: Check blood pressure at home
other.why: Home readings help your doctor adjust treatment.
other.description: Measure your blood pressure once each morning.

follow_up.description: Review your home blood pressure readings.

warning_signs.what_it_might_mean: This could be a heart problem.

questions: What blood pressure number should I aim for?
When should I call about side effects?
How long should I keep a home blood pressure log?

Hypertension.definition: Blood pressure that stays higher than normal.
